name: relief
description: Delight from a perception that physical or mental pain is feeling better.
perceptions: I was in a certain amount of pain.

variations.name: relief attributed to something or someone
variations.description: A perception that decreased physical or mental pain is attributed to help from something or someone.
perceptions: I was in a certain amount of pain.
Someone or something should be given credit for helping.
examples: the medicine seems to have worked
the doctor figured out what was wrong

commentaries.quote: We often don't understand our psychological pain and may not know how to deal it. It may help to have a basic mental 'first aid kit' that works for you, whether that's prayer, meditation, family time, or another healthy activity.
Time only helps heal if you take care of yourself consistently. That goes for mental pain as for physical.
For fast-acting relief try slowing down.
There is a great relief in experiencing the worst vicariously.

There is certain relief in change, even though it be from bad to worse! As I have often found in traveling in a stagecoach, that it is often a comfort to shift one's position, and be bruised in a new place.

names: relief attributed to something or someone
